values.note: $12.15 a night: the Indiana DNR's first-come, first-served primitive rate for state forest campgrounds, and the forest calls its sites primitive (class C). Read 2026-10-31.

facilities.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/martin-state-forest/ ('Pit toilets and drinking water are available near sites'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Self check-in station in the campground.

booking.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/martin-state-forest/ ('We do not accept reservations, camping is available on a first come, first served basis'), read 2026-10-31

note: Indiana DNR Division of Forestry, Martin State Forest family campground. Three small lakes on the property but sites are not on a shore. --Claude
summary: Fee $12-12.15 -> $12.15 (the forest's sites are primitive, class C; a camper reported $13 in 10/2025). 26 sites, no electric, FCFS confirmed; pit toilets and drinking water added.
flags: PHONE: stored empty; forest office is 812-247-3491 (https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/martin-state-forest/).

PIN: not confirmable. It sits on a short road stub north of the forest road junction under full canopy, 46 m from Google's 38.69048,-86.72872. No sites are visible in imagery and no map shows the loop; I left it.
FIT: state forest page is silent on length. RV Life 10/2025 camper fit a 35-ft fifth wheel, so 23 ft passes.
